eval_dimensions.name: Missing Playbook Override Gate (GH-271)
eval_dimensions.description: When no user playbook override exists AND the resolved default config has output_target: stdout with empty ticket_links, Step 1 fires AskUserQuestion (use defaults / save as override / customize now) before proceeding to PR collection — preventing silent fallback to an unusable default, the root cause of 3/14 compliance deviations in a prior audit.

eval_dimensions.name: Existing Override Skips the Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When a project or global playbook override already exists (at any config-resolution tier), Step 1 proceeds directly without firing the missing-override gate.

eval_dimensions.name: Missing JTBDs Delegate to jtbd in Unattended Mode
eval_dimensions.description: Step 3 invokes Dev10x:jtbd in unattended mode (not attended) for each PR missing a Job Story, then batches all drafts into a single approval prompt rather than approving one-by-one.

evals.name: No override + stdout/no-ticket-links fires the missing-override gate
evals.description: When no override exists at any config-resolution tier and the default resolves to output_target: stdout with empty ticket_links, the skill must ask before collecting PRs.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'Use defaults as-is' / 'Save defaults as project override' / 'Customize key settings now' options before Step 2 (Collect PRs) runs
No inline 'want to configure output target?' text substitutes for the widget

evals.name: An existing override skips the missing-override gate
evals.description: When a project or global playbook override is present, Step 1 loads it and proceeds directly to PR collection without firing AskUserQuestion.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called for config resolution; the project override's config block is used directly

evals.name: Non-default output_target or non-empty ticket_links skips the gate even without an override file
evals.description: The gate only fires on the specific unusable-default combination (stdout + empty ticket_links). A resolved config with output_target: github-release or non-empty ticket_links does not trigger it.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called when the resolved config already has a non-stdout output_target or non-empty ticket_links

evals.name: Missing JTBDs are drafted in unattended mode and batched
evals.description: Step 3 invokes Dev10x:jtbd in unattended mode for every PR missing a Job Story, collects all drafts, then presents one combined approval prompt — not per-PR gates.

assertions.signal: Skill(Dev10x:jtbd) is invoked once per missing-JTBD PR with mode=unattended
All drafted stories are presented in a single batched summary, not N separate per-PR AskUserQuestion gates

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the release-notes skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation with explicit tag range

should_trigger.query: generate release notes for the changes since the last tag

should_not_trigger.query: write a commit message for this change
should_not_trigger.rationale: Single commit, not a release summary — use Dev10x:git-commit

should_not_trigger.query: draft a Job Story for this one PR
